image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a white transparent compact cassette tape resting on a wooden surface. The cassette features visible internal spools, an orange write-protection tab, and printed text/graphics on the label area. The background is a blurred wooden texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object clearly exhibits the proportions of a standard cassette: a flat rectangular prism where width > height > thickness.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flat rectangular prism with rounded corners.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The overall shape is a rectangle with distinctly rounded corners, matching the physical design of cassettes.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Inside the circular holes, the characteristic gear-like structure of tape spools is visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The casing appears to be made of translucent/transparent white plastic, allowing internal components to be partially seen.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The translucency of the plastic allows the silhouette of the internal spools and tape path to be perceived.

artifact_observations.location: Label area on the top face of the cassette
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the label is illegible and appears as blurry, nonsensical glyphs rather than sharp characters. This is common in AI generation but also possible in low-res photography; however, the lack of any discernible letter shapes suggests generative artifacting.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom right corner of the cassette casing
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and lack of crisp edge definition compared to the rest of the object, potentially indicating minor melting or focus inconsistency, though it could also be depth-of-field blur.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cassette and not a similar rectangular object (e.g., VHS adapter, soap box).
To analyze the illegible text on the label and determine if it is gibberish or just out-of-focus real text.
To verify the structural integrity of the plastic casing, ensuring no floating parts or fused edges, especially around the transparent sections.
To assess if the blurriness is consistent with optical depth-of-field or indicative of generative smoothing artifacts.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of printed text on the label
Structural correctness of the internal spools visible through the plastic
Edge sharpness and boundary definition of the transparent casing
Consistency of lighting and reflections on the plastic surface
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the label. If the image_text_auditor finds no recognizable characters, treat this as a significant artifact (text_gibberish) unless the perceptual_quality_auditor confirms extreme motion blur or defocus that would naturally obliterate text. Verify that the 'spools' inside look mechanically plausible and not just like random circles.
